result.fundName: ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth

insights: ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth marginally outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 0.33% (15.16% vs 14.83%).
Only 47.8% of rolling windows beat the benchmark — weak relative consistency.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.02 vs benchmark 0.76, Sortino 1.41.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.22, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 18.14% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.22).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -24.65% vs benchmark -38.11%.
Rolling return range spans 5.46% to 28.13% (22.67 pp spread) — consistency score 69.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
